root_cause.text: In `af_alg_pull_tsgl`, the page reassignment logic did not check whether the current scatterlist entry actually contributes data (`plen`), causing it to incorrectly increment the destination scatterlist index beyond the allocated number of entries when `plen == 0`, leading to an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (dst)` to `if (dst && plen)` inside the loop, and the commit message explicitly states that "the original loop wasn't updated so it may try to reassign one more page than necessary." The comment update also removes the obsolete reference to an offset argument, confirming the fix targets the overflow condition.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add guard to skip reassignment of empty scatterlist entries (plen=0) and clarify comment.
intent_record.what: Changed the condition from 'if (dst)' to 'if (dst && plen)' and updated the comment from '/* reassign page to dst after offset */' to '/* reassign page to dst */'.
intent_record.how: The block now only executes when both dst is non-NULL and plen (length of the scatterlist entry) is non-zero, preventing the creation of zero-length scatterlist entries. The comment change removes the phrase 'after offset' as it was redundant.

grouping_result.intent: Add guard to skip reassignment of empty scatterlist entries (plen=0) and clarify comment.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly adds a guard to skip reassignment when plen==0, which is the missing check that caused the out-of-bounds write vulnerability.

candidates.rationale: This line writes to dst+j without checking if plen==0, so when plen==0, it still accesses dst+j, potentially writing beyond the allocated number of entries, causing an out-of-bounds write.
This line unconditionally increments the destination scatterlist index j even when plen==0, so j can exceed the allocated number of entries, leading to out-of-bounds access in subsequent iterations.

vuln_statements.explanation: Writes to dst+j without checking if plen==0, causing out-of-bounds access when j exceeds allocated number of entries due to empty scatterlist entries.
